text:
Aapki baat bilkul sahi hai, agle baar se packaging aur delivery par aur dhyan rakhenge. 

Aapke order ORD-22006 ka ₹2,199 ka refund successfully initiate ho gaya hai aur 3-5 working days me aapke account me aa jayega. 

Agar aapko koi aur madad chahiye ho toh zaroor bataiye ga. Dhanyawad, aapka din shubh ho!
